# TASK-022 Report-ready email

Status: blocked (see Blocker)

Outcome: when a report finishes, the shop's customers get a "your report is ready" email, as the ruling cited below allows.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0009
  Path           docs/adr/0009-no-new-kind-of-customer-message-without-approval.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b000000

## Blocker

Not built; decision: stop (2026-10-21).

- mira ADR 0009 (customer-outreach, Accepted, in force at commit 1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c) says no product sends a new kind of customer message (email, SMS or push) until Mira has approved that kind of message in the decision log. The decision log has no approval for a "your report is ready" email, so this email is a new kind of message and may not be sent yet.
- The digest cited above (sha256:0b26c259...5b000000) does not match the ruling file. The tool refused with digest_mismatch (exit 4); the actual digest is sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b6ea0ca. The cited digest is wrong or the handover is stale, so the planning agent should re-issue the reference.
- To unblock: Mira approves this kind of message in the decision log (a new ADR in ../mira-decisions, confirmed by her), and the task cites that ADR with a correct digest. Approval is also not given by ADR 0009 itself.
